RP-01 Phase-4 research is complete and the one-at-a-time decision queue is now fixed. Canonical brief: ; executable probes: , , and ; recovery authority:  (). No production or tracked file changed.

Already approved: one operation-wide Pydantic request budget with a documented raise-the-limit follow-up if legitimate recovery is starved; complete failed response on retry only when deterministic fit is proven, otherwise omit it whole; no truncation of authoritative input/output/stored history; bounded length/max_tokens retry with the approved concise-response guidance; refusal/content-filter remains terminal.

Three maintainer decisions remain, in order: (1) aggregate every successful retry attempt into the single operation usage/telemetry row; (2) on exhaustion, re-raise only the exact Rebar-owned output error found in Pydantic's cause chain and never blanket-translate UnexpectedModelBehavior; (3) preserve Pydantic requests and add candidate_requests for logical fallback/downgrade candidate calls observed through public WrapperModel. The compatibility audit found no accepted-attempt-only consumer and proved candidate_requests currently drops at four explicit allowlists that the story must update. This ticket remains in_progress through those approvals; implementation ticketization is still gated.
